nodes.label: State doc 2026-06-28: artefact arm lean-graph + live-facets build record — the COMPLETE build (every file, function, relationship, decision) of the artefact as a runnable retrieval arm; supersedes the 06-25 guide-link doc on the instrument (max-F-rephrase dropped) and DESIGN/MODEL_CONTRACTS facet sections.

Lean graph: Tag node = embedding + chunk-binding, NO phrase text in the node (phrase lives in tags jsonl, re-embeddable via embed_tags.py). Source→File→Chunk→Tag spine; hard fields as chunk attributes; references into untouched raw.

Live facets: graded structure derived query-time (NOT baked at index) — interpreter emits facet_phrases, pipelines/artefact embeds them, mean-centers against corpus mean, dot-products against the tag matrix, max-pools across facet phrases, accumulates over chunk tag rows. Dissolves the instrument + axis-definition + calibration open problems.

Heterogeneous facet profile: categorical (entity-type via directory join, info-kind via detectors DEFERRED) / graded (activity/argument/case_study via query-time clustering) / scalar (centrality DEFERRED). Replaces v1's uniform w_facet 5-vector — three different measurement natures cannot share one vector.

Pass-1 combinator: Q_c = (Q - mean_vector) re-L2-normalized; S = matrix_centered @ Q_c.T; phrase_weight[i] = max_j S[i,j]; chunk_score[j] = sum_{i in tag_rows[j]} phrase_weight[i] (ACCUMULATE not max); additive PRODUCT_LITERAL_BOOST +1.0 per wanted product literal whose products/<name>.json is in relpath. No hard filters; the cap cuts.

PreparedIndex (artefact/index.py): in-memory view of the lean graph — matrix (mean-centered + re-L2-normalized), matrix_raw (original L2-normalized), mean_vector, phrases, chunk_ids, chunk_kinds, chunk_tag_rows, phrase_to_chunks, chunks_by_id. Fails loud on stale npz (chunk set + per-chunk kind must match chunker).

Mean-centering as pass 1 of corpus-relative geometry (research §1.2): subtract corpus mean vector, re-L2-normalize; mitigates cone-effect + anisotropy + rogue dimensions. Original matrix retained for ablation. A zero-norm row after centering is left at zero.

Pre-pass exclusion polarity (lookback-anchored regex): the exclusion keyword must be the LAST word(s) immediately before the match (only an optional determiner in between). Kills false positives a bare 'within 30 chars' rule produces on real HERB phrasing ('discussed but not implemented in X', 'sets the product apart from IBM Watson') while catching 'apart from PitchForce' / 'not X'.

Interpreter model = meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct (swapped from z-ai/glm-5.1 which 429d on the first gold-100 run). One-shot temp-0 structured NIM call, no tools, response_format json_schema. Contract model-agnostic — system prompt + json_schema + MUST-NOT regexes + validation all identical across models. Swap is a one-line change at INTERPRETER_MODEL.

Interpreter MUST-NOT regex: \b(?:eid_[0-9a-f]+|CUST-\d+|PR[-#]?\d+|#\d{2,})\b|https?://\S+|\b(?:19|20)\d{2}\b|\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b — ids/dates/years/URLs/PR-numbers/channel-ids never in facet_phrases or literal tokens. _validate fails loud on any hit (no silent partial).

graph_store.py ingests the lean graph into Neo4j DB herb-v3 (NEVER herb-eval — the superseded oracle-contaminated v1 build). Tag node carries embedding (float[]) + embedding_row + embedding_dim; tag_id = {chunk_id}#{position}. :BuildMeta sentinel (chunk_count + tag_count) written LAST — its presence means ingest finished. BLOCKED on Neo4j running + NEO4J_PASSWORD.

context_ids = chunk_artifact_ids(chunk, data_root, cache): for each ref, walk its pointer back to /collection/index, resolve that record (hash-verified, memoized), read its top-level id field, dedupe. Same id space as gold citations + other arms' context_ids, so RAGAS citation-based metrics compare like-for-like.

Eval result (gold-100 k=10 retrieval-only): context_recall_id 0.199 (n=99) vs lucene 0.035 (n=100) vs vector 0.045 (n=100) — ~4-5x the gold-citation recall. The structured facet-channel retrieval + product-literal boost finds the right artifacts far more reliably than dense/sparse baselines.

Eval result: context_precision_id 0.068 vs lucene 0.102 vs vector 0.148 — LOWER. The accumulate-not-max + dedupe design emits more ids per question (k=10 chunks → up to ~67 deduped context_ids vs 10 for baselines), so precision-by-id is diluted. High recall, lower precision — the design's hand.

BLOCKER: shared generator qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b hard-down (ReadTimeout after 365s per call). --retrieval-only flag added to run.py routes around it (build_shared_generator returns None; ArmOutput.answer empty). Judged metrics (faithfulness/answer_correctness/context_recall_llm) blocked — same model is the judge.

1/100 MUST-NOT violation: llama-3.3-70b emitted eid_bac7c6c4 as a literal token for PersonalizeForce::a::34. The _validate fail-loud caught it (no silent partial); the run continued. Per-model violation rate is an open measurement (1/100 for llama-3.3-70b; glm-5.1 unmeasurable — 429d).

REJECTED: the uniform facet vector (v1's w_facet 5-vector on every tag), baking graded facets at index, per-facet edges, facets-on-chunk, model-emitted numbers, stance-via-geometry, phrase text in the graph node, the max-F-rephrase instrument (rewrite-distance conflates incidental wording + topic leak + facet change), hard filters in ranking, 'facet = relevance coordinate', the entities/evidence misread, the v2 five-facet set as canon, comparing a tag to an abstract facet-label embedding, the chunk description, designing from the retrieval side.

Immediate next task (fork): (A) aggregate-path design pass — semantic filter + full recall + group-by-attribute + directory-join (DESIGN §14.6 structural-query path; 30+ HERB questions are answer_shape=aggregate, currently logged + returned as top-k); OR (B) wait for NIM + judged-metric comparison (re-run gold-100 k=10 with generator up + k=5).
